company.name: Innotech
company.shortDescription: Innotechi is a technology company that specializes in automating concrete industries processes using it's 3D printing technology.
company.description:
Innotech innovated MENA's first low-carbon concrete 3d printer, to automate concrete industries in order to speed up the process, reduce the cost, and enable the casting of complex structures. The startup raised about $3m USD of VC funding and $300k USD of grants from Oman, Saudi Arabia and Bahrain. 

The startup delivered several 3d printed buildings and then pivoted to 3d printed artificial reefs with already 3 successful deployments in Oman audited by 3rd party auditors.
